messages.subject: Using control samples as background
parts:
Hi,

I have three different conditions in my analysis, 2 correspond to different tumor samples and my control. I have managed to get DMRs between control and tumor1, control and tumor2 and between tumor1 and tumor2.

However, I have been advised that it would be best if I could obtain a comparison between tumor1 and tumor2 using control as a "background" calibration? I am unfamiliar with this process, but the idea is apparently similar to what can be done with limma in RNAseq.

I was wondering if you would have any idea / have heard of this and might be able to point me in the right direction.

Thanks!
Alejandra
